tensorize_input: encode a prompt string into a PyTorch tensor with a BOS token prepended using a ByteLevelBPETokenizer
get_next_token: decode the most likely next token from model logits using argmax and a ByteLevelBPETokenizer
setup_vocab_and_merges: load GPT-2 vocab and merges files from a model path and return a ByteLevelBPETokenizer instance
BPEHubInterface_encode_decode: encode or decode a sentence using a configured Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizer via the hub interface
GeneratorInterface_generate: generate text sequences from a pre-trained language model with configurable temperature, top-p, beam search, and repetition penalties
